review_method: Reconstruct all 140 frozen records from the v642-v7 index chain. Compare every candidate title, mission surface, hypothesis, null or failure condition, approval class, execution lane, source need, artifact set, falsifier, rollback, protected gate, expected disposition, and novelty statement against those records; require a mechanism-level delta rather than synonym replacement.

checks.semantic_delta: Moves from ancestry, atomic receipts, traceability, and citation identity to append-only inclusion, cross-size consistency, and explicit equivocation while separating log membership from truth.

Quotients an explicit EFT operator list by integration-by-parts and declared equations-of-motion redundancy rather than testing field-redefinition identifiability, kinetic Hessians, constraints, or degree-of-freedom counts.
Pins EFT cutoff, expansion parameter, order sequence, and truncation remainder rather than solver tolerance, posterior checks, prior conflict, or calibration covariance.
Freezes outcome-instrument structure and measurement-invariance criteria before arm decoding rather than scorer agreement, safety stopping, dropout handling, or intercurrent-event estimands.
Binds one-use challenge freshness to domain, verifier audience, proof purpose, and time window rather than key rotation, suite agility, confused-deputy purpose, or schema evolution.

Preserves unknown, absent, withheld, disputed, and protected evidence states and forbids technical burden or adverse-inference allocation; prior work centered participation, dissent, wording scope, or forum competence.

Pins a Unicode confusable-skeleton profile specifically for cross-artifact identifiers while preserving ordinary prose; prior work handled parser validity, adversarial encodings, corpora, or Windows path aliases.
Freezes signed-zero, NaN, infinity, ULP, cancellation, summation order, and comparison policy rather than generic tolerance, environment, time-locale, or PRNG replay.
Tests trajectory dependence, reversal, hysteresis, and state-function non-substitution rather than entropy domains, aggregation levels, open boundaries, or state-rate typing.

Makes reversibility class, rollback evidence, blast radius, and irreversible external-state authority one embargo contract rather than a freshness board, evidence-class firewall, cut set, or asymmetric-loss board.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first broad skill-file inventory exceeded the ten-second command window before locating the named index skill.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Used the exact known skill path, read the complete skill, and did not mutate repository state.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A filtered directory probe for the named skill also exceeded the ten-second command window.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Read the exact skill file directly with a bounded sixty-second call and then read its required routing reference in full.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first combined uniqueness probe embedded command execution inside a PowerShell hash literal and failed to parse before producing a result.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Separated command exit states into variables and reran only read-only uniqueness checks before creation.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: An initial worktree-name regex included the short token arc and matched the shared Archives path, yielding 91 irrelevant worktree hits.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Repeated the uniqueness audit with the exact sylven-arc-v642-v8 slug and confirmed zero tracked, branch, remote, worktree, and path collisions.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The authorized additive worktree checkout exceeded the sixty-second wrapper window.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Did not retry blindly. Audited the existing path and worktree registry and confirmed the unique branch, exact source head, clean status, and registered additive lane.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A compact proposal-chain output attempt used a PowerShell escape inside a JavaScript template and failed before reading records.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Removed the conflicting escape and reran the read-only reconstruction using structured JSON output.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first recursive proposal reconstruction assumed every inherited index used new_records and therefore exposed only 21 entries, including a null base marker.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Inspected each schema, used the 120-record flattened v642-v5 base plus v642-v6 and v642-v7 deltas, and independently confirmed exactly 140 inherited records.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A source-ledger traversal used a colon immediately after a PowerShell variable and failed parser validation.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Rewrote the diagnostic message as string concatenation and left all source files untouched.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The next source-ledger traversal escaped the PowerShell issue with syntax that was instead interpreted by the JavaScript wrapper.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Removed template interpolation from the shell payload, reran the read-only traversal, and confirmed all 69 inherited sources.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A pre-stage exact-path diagnostic used short Git status, which collapsed the new owner directory to one entry instead of enumerating its files.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Kept the diagnostic limitation and switched to explicit untracked-file enumeration before staging and cached-path enumeration after staging.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A supplemental absolute-path regex treated URL scheme text as drive-letter paths and reported twelve false positives.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Retained the false-positive result and used the family privacy scanner's bounded Windows-path pattern plus semantic review instead.

boundary: Semantic distinctness is a preregistration review result, not proof that the proposals are scientifically true, externally novel, authorized, completed, or production-ready.
